subject: Source-independence queue: items 1-2 PASS on darwin; here is exactly what the runner lacks for items 2-3
body:
Both runnable operations passed. The gap for the parity session is narrower than 'needs new operations' — most of it exists, and one specific thing does not.

RAN at aa239cf, clean tree:

  live-telemetry  PASS (10s)   signalgrid_up traversed api /metrics -> collector -> prometheus
  live-fleet      PASS (34s)   fleet v4.89.2 + osquery 5.17.0 under emulation, 2 hosts enrolled,
                               proof:live-fleet green, containers removed by the run

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS, so do not rebuild it:

  --keep                      run-live-lanes.sh:12,34,111 — present and documented
  proof:evidence-adapter      scripts/src/evidence-adapter-proof.ts — present, and it ALREADY
                              proves the source-agnostic claim across three adapters
                              (Fleet host report, Headwind-shaped Android, Intune-shaped),
                              asserting identical outcomes and reason codes with only
                              provenance differing
  21 sim operations           including live-lanes, live-fleet, live-telemetry

WHAT IS ACTUALLY MISSING, in dependency order:

1. A LIVE HEADWIND CE LANE. run-live-lanes.sh has five lanes — fleet, location, keycloak, edr, telemetry. There is no headwind lane and no Headwind image pinned in container-engine.sh. Every existing 'Headwind' reference is a FIXTURE SHAPE, not a running server: evidence-adapter-proof.ts:152 says so in as many words, 'headwind-shaped android lab adapter (fixture shape, not a family)'. So item 2 cannot be a parity session between two LIVE sources today, because only one of the two sources can be stood up.

2. A LIVE-CAPTURE PATH INTO THE PROOF. proof:evidence-adapter runs at mode 'fixture' (line 209) with fetch replaced by a tripwire (zero network, enforced by design). It cannot currently consume a live capture from either source. Proving 'SAME decisions from either LIVE source' needs a capture step — live lane -> normalized DeviceManagementEvidence written to disk -> the proof reading those captures instead of its fixtures. That is a Core-lane change to a proof, not a runner change, and it touches the zero-network tripwire, so it wants your judgement on whether the proof stays hermetic and a NEW proof consumes captures.

3. GLPI: NOTHING EXISTS. No lane, no image pin, no operation, no adapter — zero matches for 'glpi' anywhere under scripts/. Item 3 is a from-scratch bring-up, not a wiring job.

MY READ, yours to overrule: item 2's value is the LIVE half, and the honest version of it is two commits — first a headwind lane in run-live-lanes.sh so both sources can actually run, then the capture path. Shipping only a sim operation would give you a green that still compares two fixtures, which proof:evidence-adapter already does hermetically and better. I would rather report the gap than produce that green.

I can build the headwind lane on this Mac if you want it — it is run-live-lanes.sh plus a pinned image in container-engine.sh, both surfaces the Mac lane touches. Say so and it is next. The capture path and the GLPI adapter are Core-lane work by the ownership map.
